notes: Undergraduate and graduate calendars are published separately and disagree on several dates; twelve apparent discrepancies are transcribed in the resource and are deliberately not repaired. The published catalog edition (2025-2026) lags the calendar year (2026-2027). sha256 is null for every source. Each page was located and read at its public URL on 2026-08-31, but the network egress available during collection could not re-download raw response bodies for hashing, so no digest is asserted rather than a fabricated one. Agent 5 owns hashing via tools/fetch_sources.py; digests must be populated by that pipeline (or an equivalent unrestricted re-fetch) before this sidecar can pass a schema that requires 64 hex characters. retrieved_at reflects the collection session on 2026-08-31.
